properties.name: Test results from wherever the code runs flow back into the design, wherever the design lives
properties.statement: When an implementation is tested — on the owner's machine or in its repository's CI — the results reach the design and are compared against its checks, even when the design is hosted elsewhere (flo2.io), through an authenticated path. From Anthony, 2026-09-25: "when implemented design is being tested, feedback needs to be put back in the reflow2 design object."
